name: album-cover-director
description: Create release-ready album covers where the title becomes a physical world or shares one hierarchy with a central figure.

interface.longDescription: Turns a title plus lyrics, a music description, or audio into cover directions built around material title-worlds or character-led title systems; generates and evaluates artwork; applies a dedicated title-image gate; and prepares square delivery assets.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $album-cover-director to create three image-native title-system cover directions from this track.
